transition-colors inline-block" href="/help">← Back</a><div class="prose prose-lg max-w-none"><h1 class="text-large mb-8">Give your Bot an email address</h1>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">You can claim an email address for your Bots at <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">mail.grokbot.com</code>, such as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">yourname@mail.grokbot.com</code>. Your Bots can then receive, read, search, and send email from it.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">With an address, a Bot can:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Sign up for services with its own address, and pick up the verification code or link with your OK.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Collect receipts, newsletters, and reports, and summarize them for you.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Send email for you, such as a digest or an update, and handle replies, once you&#x27;ve asked it to.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Run a routine when email arrives, optionally only from specific senders.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-do-i-get-an-email-address-for-my-bot"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-do-i-get-an-email-address-for-my-bot" data-heading-base-id="how-do-i-get-an-email-address-for-my-bot" aria-label="Copy link to how-do-i-get-an-email-address-for-my-bot"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How do I get an email address for my Bot?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">You can claim it two ways:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Ask your Bot.</strong> Say something like &quot;Get yourself an email address.&quot; The Bot asks what name you want, checks that it&#x27;s free, and shows an approval card. Nothing is claimed until you approve.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Use the Email plugin.</strong> On desktop, open the plugin marketplace from the sidebar and choose <strong>Email</strong>. On the phone, open <strong>Settings</strong> &gt; <strong>Plugins</strong> &gt; <strong>Email</strong>. Under <strong>Email address</strong>, type a name in <strong>Choose a name</strong>, then choose <strong>Create address</strong>.</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">After you claim it, the plugin shows your address with a button to copy it.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If you use Grok Bot through a Cursor team, a team admin has to turn on agent email first. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#how-do-team-admins-turn-on-agent-email">How do team admins turn on agent email?</a></p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="what-names-can-i-choose"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#what-names-can-i-choose" data-heading-base-id="what-names-can-i-choose" aria-label="Copy link to what-names-can-i-choose"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">What names can I choose?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Use lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens, and underscores.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Start and end with a letter or digit.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Use at most 64 characters.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Avoid reserved words such as support, admin, billing, security, help, info, team, cursor, grok, and xai.</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Every address is unique. Once someone claims an address, it&#x27;s never given to anyone else, even after the account that claimed it is deleted.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="can-i-have-more-than-one-address-or-change-mine"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#can-i-have-more-than-one-address-or-change-mine" data-heading-base-id="can-i-have-more-than-one-address-or-change-mine" aria-label="Copy link to can-i-have-more-than-one-address-or-change-mine"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Can I have more than one address, or change mine?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">You can have one address. You can&#x27;t rename it or delete it, so choose the name carefully.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="which-of-my-bots-can-use-my-address"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#which-of-my-bots-can-use-my-address" data-heading-base-id="which-of-my-bots-can-use-my-address" aria-label="Copy link to which-of-my-bots-can-use-my-address"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Which of my Bots can use my address?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">The address belongs to you, not to one Bot. All of your Bots can use it in your own chats with them, and in routines you set up.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Bots can&#x27;t use your address in Slack threads or in chats where someone else is talking to the Bot. A <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/grok-bot/team-bots">Team Bot</a> doesn&#x27;t have a shared team address.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="who-can-email-my-bot-and-where-do-i-see-the-mail"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#who-can-email-my-bot-and-where-do-i-see-the-mail" data-heading-base-id="who-can-email-my-bot-and-where-do-i-see-the-mail" aria-label="Copy link to who-can-email-my-bot-and-where-do-i-see-the-mail"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Who can email my Bot, and where do I see the mail?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Anyone can send email to your address. Mail that fails the spam or virus scan is kept without its body or attachments, and it never starts a routine.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">There&#x27;s no inbox view in the apps, and you don&#x27;t get notifications for new mail. To see your mail, ask your Bot, for example &quot;What arrived in your inbox today?&quot; or &quot;Find the receipt from last week.&quot; Mail that arrived in the last minute may not show up in a search yet.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Each message can include up to 10 attachments, up to 10 MB each and 25 MB in total. Attachments beyond those limits are skipped.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-do-i-have-my-bot-act-on-incoming-email"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-do-i-have-my-bot-act-on-incoming-email" data-heading-base-id="how-do-i-have-my-bot-act-on-incoming-email" aria-label="Copy link to how-do-i-have-my-bot-act-on-incoming-email"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How do I have my Bot act on incoming email?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Set up a routine. New mail doesn&#x27;t start a chat or wake a Bot on its own. A Bot acts on incoming mail only through a routine you create.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Ask your Bot in chat, for example &quot;When an email arrives from <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="mailto:billing@example.com">billing@example.com</a>, summarize it and tell me.&quot; A routine can watch for:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Mail from anyone.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Mail from specific addresses, such as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">billing@example.com</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Mail from a whole domain, such as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">*@example.com</code>.</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">By default, the routine only runs for mail from senders that pass standard email authentication checks. Routines can&#x27;t filter by subject. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/grok-bot/routines">Routines</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="does-my-bot-need-my-approval-to-send-email"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#does-my-bot-need-my-approval-to-send-email" data-heading-base-id="does-my-bot-need-my-approval-to-send-email" aria-label="Copy link to does-my-bot-need-my-approval-to-send-email"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Does my Bot need my approval to send email?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Yes. Your Bot sends email only when you&#x27;ve asked it to, either in chat or in a routine&#x27;s instructions. Otherwise it shows you the full draft and asks first. Replying counts as sending.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If <strong>Auto-review</strong> is on, sends are checked the same way as other actions, and some sends always ask you. Instructions inside an email the Bot received never count as your permission to send.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If you&#x27;ve also connected Gmail or Outlook, your Bot asks which account to send from when either could work.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="are-there-limits-on-what-my-bot-can-send"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#are-there-limits-on-what-my-bot-can-send" data-heading-base-id="are-there-limits-on-what-my-bot-can-send" aria-label="Copy link to are-there-limits-on-what-my-bot-can-send"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Are there limits on what my Bot can send?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Up to 50 recipients per email, across To, Cc, and Bcc.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Up to 10 attachments, up to 10 MB each and 25 MB in total. Executable files can&#x27;t be attached.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Newsletters and first-contact emails go to one recipient per message and include a one-click unsubscribe link.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">If a message bounces, or someone unsubscribes or marks it as spam, your Bot stops emailing that address and tells you who it skipped.</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">There are also limits on how many new people a Bot can email, to protect the address from being flagged as spam.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-is-email-content-kept-safe"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-is-email-content-kept-safe" data-heading-base-id="how-is-email-content-kept-safe" aria-label="Copy link to how-is-email-content-kept-safe"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How is email content kept safe?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Your Bot treats email from other people as information, not instructions. Each message it reads is marked as from you or from someone else, and a request inside an email doesn&#x27;t make it send anything or take other actions on its own.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If you delete your Grok Bot account, your mail and attachments are deleted. The address itself is retired and never given to anyone else. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/grok-bot/delete-account">Delete your Grok Bot account</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-do-team-admins-turn-on-agent-email"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-do-team-admins-turn-on-agent-email" data-heading-base-id="how-do-team-admins-turn-on-agent-email" aria-label="Copy link to how-do-team-admins-turn-on-agent-email"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How do team admins turn on agent email?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For Cursor teams, agent email is off by default. A team admin turns it on in the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/bot">Cursor dashboard</a>: on the <strong>Grok Bot</strong> page, under <strong>Bot Capabilities</strong>, turn on <strong>Agent Email</strong>. Members can then claim an address.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If an admin turns agent email off later, Bots lose their email tools and email routines stop running. Mail sent to existing addresses is still received and kept, and members keep their addresses.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="why-cant-i-claim-an-address"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#why-cant-i-claim-an-address" data-heading-base-id="why-cant-i-claim-an-address" aria-label="Copy link to why-cant-i-claim-an-address"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Why can&#x27;t I claim an address?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<div class="my-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-sm border dark:border-muted"><table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-neutral-200 bg-card dark:divide-muted dark:bg-card"><thead class="dark:text-neutral-300"><tr><th class="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium text-xs" scope="col">What you see</th><th class="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium text-xs" scope="col">What to do</th></tr></thead><tbody class="divide-y divide-neutral-200 bg-background dark:divide-muted"><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap"><strong>Agent email is not enabled for this account.</strong></td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">Agent email isn&#x27;t available on your account yet.</td></tr><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap"><strong>Your team admin has turned off Grok Bot agent email, so this account cannot claim or use an agent email address.</strong></td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">Ask your team admin to turn on <strong>Agent Email</strong>. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#how-do-team-admins-turn-on-agent-email">How do team admins turn on agent email?</a></td></tr><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap"><strong>That address is taken, and addresses are never reissued, so retrying it cannot succeed. Choose a different name.</strong></td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">Choose a different name.</td></tr><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">A message about allowed characters, length, or a reserved word</td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">Pick a name that follows <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#what-names-can-i-choose">the name rules</a>.</td></tr><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap"><strong>You can have one agent email address.</strong></td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">You already have an address. Ask your Bot what it is, or open the <strong>Email</strong> plugin.</td></tr><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap"><strong>Couldn&#x27;t create your email address. Try again.</strong> (phone)</td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">Check the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#what-names-can-i-choose">name rules</a>, or try on desktop, which shows the exact reason.</td></tr><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap"><strong>Too many email addresses checked in the last minute.</strong></td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">Wait a minute, then try again.</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If none of these match, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/grok-bot/get-help">contact support</a> with your Cursor account email and the exact message.</p>

max-w-7xl space-y-8"><div class="flex mx-auto max-w-5xl"><div class="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-8 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 pt-8 pb-8 max-w-3xl"><a class="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors inline-block" href="/help">← Back</a><div class="prose prose-lg max-w-none"><h1 class="text-large mb-8">Give your Bot an email address</h1>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">You can claim an email address for your Bots at <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">mail.grokbot.com</code>, such as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">yourname@mail.grokbot.com</code>. Your Bots can then receive, read, search, and send email from it.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">With an address, a Bot can:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Sign up for services with its own address, and pick up the verification code or link with your OK.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Collect receipts, newsletters, and reports, and summarize them for you.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Send email for you, such as a digest or an update, and handle replies, once you&#x27;ve asked it to.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Run a routine when email arrives, optionally only from specific senders.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-do-i-get-an-email-address-for-my-bot"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-do-i-get-an-email-address-for-my-bot" data-heading-base-id="how-do-i-get-an-email-address-for-my-bot" aria-label="Copy link to how-do-i-get-an-email-address-for-my-bot"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How do I get an email address for my Bot?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">You can claim it two ways:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Ask your Bot.</strong> Say something like &quot;Get yourself an email address.&quot; The Bot asks what name you want, checks that it&#x27;s free, and shows an approval card. Nothing is claimed until you approve.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Use the Email plugin.</strong> On desktop, open the plugin marketplace from the sidebar and choose <strong>Email</strong>. On the phone, open <strong>Settings</strong> &gt; <strong>Plugins</strong> &gt; <strong>Email</strong>. Under <strong>Email address</strong>, type a name in <strong>Choose a name</strong>, then choose <strong>Create address</strong>.</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">After you claim it, the plugin shows your address with a button to copy it.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If you use Grok Bot through a Cursor team, a team admin has to turn on agent email first. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#how-do-team-admins-turn-on-agent-email">How do team admins turn on agent email?</a></p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="what-names-can-i-choose"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#what-names-can-i-choose" data-heading-base-id="what-names-can-i-choose" aria-label="Copy link to what-names-can-i-choose"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">What names can I choose?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Use lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens, and underscores.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Start and end with a letter or digit.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Use at most 64 characters.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Avoid reserved words such as support, admin, billing, security, help, info, team, cursor, grok, and xai.</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Every address is unique. Once someone claims an address, it&#x27;s never given to anyone else, even after the account that claimed it is deleted.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="can-i-have-more-than-one-address-or-change-mine"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#can-i-have-more-than-one-address-or-change-mine" data-heading-base-id="can-i-have-more-than-one-address-or-change-mine" aria-label="Copy link to can-i-have-more-than-one-address-or-change-mine"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Can I have more than one address, or change mine?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">You can have one address. You can&#x27;t rename it or delete it, so choose the name carefully.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="which-of-my-bots-can-use-my-address"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#which-of-my-bots-can-use-my-address" data-heading-base-id="which-of-my-bots-can-use-my-address" aria-label="Copy link to which-of-my-bots-can-use-my-address"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Which of my Bots can use my address?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">The address belongs to you, not to one Bot. All of your Bots can use it in your own chats with them, and in routines you set up.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Bots can&#x27;t use your address in Slack threads or in chats where someone else is talking to the Bot. A <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/grok-bot/team-bots">Team Bot</a> doesn&#x27;t have a shared team address.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="who-can-email-my-bot-and-where-do-i-see-the-mail"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#who-can-email-my-bot-and-where-do-i-see-the-mail" data-heading-base-id="who-can-email-my-bot-and-where-do-i-see-the-mail" aria-label="Copy link to who-can-email-my-bot-and-where-do-i-see-the-mail"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Who can email my Bot, and where do I see the mail?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Anyone can send email to your address. Mail that fails the spam or virus scan is kept without its body or attachments, and it never starts a routine.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">There&#x27;s no inbox view in the apps, and you don&#x27;t get notifications for new mail. To see your mail, ask your Bot, for example &quot;What arrived in your inbox today?&quot; or &quot;Find the receipt from last week.&quot; Mail that arrived in the last minute may not show up in a search yet.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Each message can include up to 10 attachments, up to 10 MB each and 25 MB in total. Attachments beyond those limits are skipped.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-do-i-have-my-bot-act-on-incoming-email"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-do-i-have-my-bot-act-on-incoming-email" data-heading-base-id="how-do-i-have-my-bot-act-on-incoming-email" aria-label="Copy link to how-do-i-have-my-bot-act-on-incoming-email"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How do I have my Bot act on incoming email?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Set up a routine. New mail doesn&#x27;t start a chat or wake a Bot on its own. A Bot acts on incoming mail only through a routine you create.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Ask your Bot in chat, for example &quot;When an email arrives from <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="mailto:billing@example.com">billing@example.com</a>, summarize it and tell me.&quot; A routine can watch for:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Mail from anyone.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Mail from specific addresses, such as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">billing@example.com</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Mail from a whole domain, such as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">*@example.com</code>.</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">By default, the routine only runs for mail from senders that pass standard email authentication checks. Routines can&#x27;t filter by subject. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/grok-bot/routines">Routines</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="does-my-bot-need-my-approval-to-send-email"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#does-my-bot-need-my-approval-to-send-email" data-heading-base-id="does-my-bot-need-my-approval-to-send-email" aria-label="Copy link to does-my-bot-need-my-approval-to-send-email"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Does my Bot need my approval to send email?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Yes. Your Bot sends email only when you&#x27;ve asked it to, either in chat or in a routine&#x27;s instructions. Otherwise it shows you the full draft and asks first. Replying counts as sending.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If <strong>Auto-review</strong> is on, sends are checked the same way as other actions, and some sends always ask you. Instructions inside an email the Bot received never count as your permission to send.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If you&#x27;ve also connected Gmail or Outlook, your Bot asks which account to send from when either could work.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="are-there-limits-on-what-my-bot-can-send"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#are-there-limits-on-what-my-bot-can-send" data-heading-base-id="are-there-limits-on-what-my-bot-can-send" aria-label="Copy link to are-there-limits-on-what-my-bot-can-send"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Are there limits on what my Bot can send?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Up to 50 recipients per email, across To, Cc, and Bcc.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Up to 10 attachments, up to 10 MB each and 25 MB in total. Executable files can&#x27;t be attached.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Newsletters and first-contact emails go to one recipient per message and include a one-click unsubscribe link.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">If a message bounces, or someone unsubscribes or marks it as spam, your Bot stops emailing that address and tells you who it skipped.</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">There are also limits on how many new people a Bot can email, to protect the address from being flagged as spam.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-is-email-content-kept-safe"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-is-email-content-kept-safe" data-heading-base-id="how-is-email-content-kept-safe" aria-label="Copy link to how-is-email-content-kept-safe"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How is email content kept safe?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Your Bot treats email from other people as information, not instructions. Each message it reads is marked as from you or from someone else, and a request inside an email doesn&#x27;t make it send anything or take other actions on its own.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If you delete your Grok Bot account, your mail and attachments are deleted. The address itself is retired and never given to anyone else. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/grok-bot/delete-account">Delete your Grok Bot account</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-do-team-admins-turn-on-agent-email"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-do-team-admins-turn-on-agent-email" data-heading-base-id="how-do-team-admins-turn-on-agent-email" aria-label="Copy link to how-do-team-admins-turn-on-agent-email"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How do team admins turn on agent email?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For Cursor teams, agent email is off by default. A team admin turns it on in the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/bot">Cursor dashboard</a>: on the <strong>Grok Bot</strong> page, under <strong>Bot Capabilities</strong>, turn on <strong>Agent Email</strong>. Members can then claim an address.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If an admin turns agent email off later, Bots lose their email tools and email routines stop running. Mail sent to existing addresses is still received and kept, and members keep their addresses.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="why-cant-i-claim-an-address"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#why-cant-i-claim-an-address" data-heading-base-id="why-cant-i-claim-an-address" aria-label="Copy link to why-cant-i-claim-an-address"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Why can&#x27;t I claim an address?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<div class="my-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-sm border dark:border-muted"><table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-neutral-200 bg-card dark:divide-muted dark:bg-card"><thead class="dark:text-neutral-300"><tr><th class="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium text-xs" scope="col">What you see</th><th class="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium text-xs" scope="col">What to do</th></tr></thead><tbody class="divide-y divide-neutral-200 bg-background dark:divide-muted"><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap"><strong>Agent email is not enabled for this account.</strong></td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">Agent email isn&#x27;t available on your account yet.</td></tr><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap"><strong>Your team admin has turned off Grok Bot agent email, so this account cannot claim or use an agent email address.</strong></td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">Ask your team admin to turn on <strong>Agent Email</strong>. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#how-do-team-admins-turn-on-agent-email">How do team admins turn on agent email?</a></td></tr><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap"><strong>That address is taken, and addresses are never reissued, so retrying it cannot succeed. Choose a different name.</strong></td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">Choose a different name.</td></tr><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">A message about allowed characters, length, or a reserved word</td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">Pick a name that follows <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#what-names-can-i-choose">the name rules</a>.</td></tr><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap"><strong>You can have one agent email address.</strong></td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">You already have an address. Ask your Bot what it is, or open the <strong>Email</strong> plugin.</td></tr><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap"><strong>Couldn&#x27;t create your email address. Try again.</strong> (phone)</td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">Check the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#what-names-can-i-choose">name rules</a>, or try on desktop, which shows the exact reason.</td></tr><tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap"><strong>Too many email addresses checked in the last minute.</strong></td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-neutral-900 text-base dark:text-neutral-100 [&amp;:first-child_code]:whitespace-nowrap">Wait a minute, then try again.</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If none of these match, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/grok-bot/get-help">contact support</a> with your Cursor account email and the exact message.</p>
